GitHub identifies a commit SHA as the safest reusable-workflow reference. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax)) Based on learnings, `@main` and release tags are both mutable; neither is an immutable pin. _Source: Learnings_
